searchText: What would break if addresses were extended to 40 bytes? Legacy contracts? Anyway, see https://notes.ethereum.org/@ipsilon/address-space-extension-issues Why would you want more data? Is there a channel for discussion about account abstraction? I was wondering about splitting addresses into two 20 byte segments: 20 bytes for a contract address, 20 bytes under the control of said contract Now that I think about it, it would work just as well if contracts got 34 bytes of data There's no reason to limit it
